Body `{ email, password }`; the academy comes from the Host header. 403 `{ code }`: DEVICE_LIMIT, SESSION_ON_OTHER_DEVICE, USER_SUSPENDED, NO_ACCESS, TENANT_PAUSED, USE_STAFF_SIGN_IN, EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED. 5 per minute per IP. Sets the session and device cookies.

**Who:** Anyone (no session), on an academy host.

**Served by:** Next.js (Better Auth).

400.description: Bad Request. Usually due to missing parameters, or invalid parameters.

401.description: Unauthorized. Due to missing or invalid authentication.

403.description: Forbidden. You do not have permission to access this resource or to perform this action.

404.description: Not Found. The requested resource was not found.

429.description: Too Many Requests. You have exceeded the rate limit. Try again later.

500.description: Internal Server Error. This is a problem with the server that you cannot fix.

post.summary: Student sign-in with device rules

info.title: Itqan API
info.description:
Multi-tenant LMS API. The academy comes from the Host header: open these docs on `http://<slug>.localhost:8080/api/docs` for academy routes and `http://admin.localhost:8080/api/docs` for platform routes, so Try it out stays on the same origin (see README, dev gateway). Sign in first through `/api/auth/sign-in/email` (staff) or `/api/auth/sign-in/student`; the cookies then carry over.

Errors: `{ "statusCode", "reason", "message" }`; Better Auth routes answer `{ "code" }`.

tags.name: Authentication & Accounts
tags.description: Sign-in, sessions, passwords and email verification (Better Auth, served by Next.js under /api/auth), and the signed-in user's own account. No two-factor routes (ADR-012).

tags.name: Guardian Consent
tags.description: Consent for students under 18, once per person (ADR-014): guardian email link or offline form. Until it is given, a minor's content and attempt routes answer 403 GUARDIAN_CONSENT_REQUIRED.

tags.name: Invitations & Joining
tags.description: Invitations for every role (one email each) and registration or acceptance with the token.

tags.name: Access Codes
